# E-000 Epic title

Save as `docs/epics/E-000-<slug>.md`. Owner: Product Owner. Create an Epic when two or more Features share one outcome; a single Feature links to its Direction instead.

| Field          | Value                   |
| -------------- | ----------------------- |
| Direction      | DIR-001                 |
| Status         | Draft / Approved / Done |
| outcome_status | Not measured            |

## Outcome

In one or two sentences, state what changes for the user and how the outcome will be observed. Keep shared outcome details here; Features link to them.

## Features

Link to each Feature's scope and delivery record instead of copying its status.

| Feature | Contribution to outcome |
| ------- | ----------------------- |
| F-000   | Link and one line       |

## Out of scope

- Items deliberately excluded.
